tasks.title: Broad literature mapping across sub-fields
tasks.description: Collect and organize papers across all relevant sub-fields, building a comprehensive bibliography with key metadata.

tasks.title: Create taxonomy and conceptual framework
tasks.description: Cluster papers into a multi-level taxonomy, define category boundaries, and identify cross-cutting themes.

tasks.title: Analyze research trends and trajectory
tasks.description: Track temporal evolution of methods, identify emerging directions, and map citation networks.

tasks.title: Formulate central thesis and argument structure
tasks.description: Define the position paper's core thesis, supporting arguments, anticipated counterarguments, and rhetorical strategy.

tasks.title: Evaluate argument strength with multi-persona review
tasks.description: Stress-test the thesis from multiple perspectives: proponent, skeptic, practitioner, and theorist.

tasks.title: Collect supporting evidence and counterexamples
tasks.description: Gather empirical evidence, case studies, and counterexamples that strengthen or challenge the thesis.

tasks.title: Develop illustrative case studies
tasks.description: Select and analyze representative case studies that concretely demonstrate the paper's arguments.

tasks.title: Run lightweight empirical validation
tasks.description: If applicable, run small-scale experiments or meta-analyses that provide quantitative support for key claims.

tasks.title: Write the position/survey paper
tasks.description: Draft the paper with structured argumentation, comprehensive related work, and forward-looking discussion.

tasks.title: Generate taxonomy and trend figures
tasks.description: Create taxonomy diagrams, trend plots, comparison tables, and conceptual illustrations.

tasks.title: Simulated peer review
tasks.description: Three-reviewer simulation focusing on argument coherence, coverage completeness, and scholarly contribution.

tasks.title: Audit all citations
tasks.description: Verify every reference exists, check cited claims, flag fabricated references.

tasks.title: Create presentation slides
tasks.description: Generate academic slide deck presenting the taxonomy, thesis, and key insights.
